description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_Queue', which implements a simple array-backed queue data structure based on the Okasaki approach. It provides methods for enqueueing, dequeueing, and checking if the queue is empty, with an emphasis on amortized efficiency.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Queue
classes.description: A class implementing an efficient, array-based queue using two stacks (input and output). It supports enqueue and dequeue operations with amortized O(1) time complexity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the queue with an optional input array.

methods.name: shift
methods.description: Removes and returns the front element of the queue; rebalances stacks if necessary.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Enqueues an element at the back of the queue.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.
